objects.name: Can’t Patch PHP2Shell Yet? Build a Stopgap with the Controls You Own
objects.description: Executive Summary PHP2Shell’s fix is to update PHP, but patching at scale is slow. Only 199,000 of 156 million PHP installations were patched in the first 12 hours after disclosure. In the meantime, Qualys’s configuration-level mitigation reduces exposure to the confirmed attack path without code changes, with or without an agent.
